sites.name: Signal Notes
sites.summary: A dark, grid-based research archive that combines a company table with deep profile notes.
sites.pattern: Persistent section rail plus progressive disclosure
sites.caution: Complex diagrams can overpower long-form reading.

sites.name: MotionDeck Studio
sites.summary: A light technical workspace for browsing, creating, and connecting visual assets.
sites.pattern: Dense library navigation with task-oriented modes
sites.caution: High control counts need strong grouping and defaults.

sites.name: Fleeting
sites.summary: A dark game-development workbook that makes systems, playtests, and roadmap state visible.
sites.pattern: Numbered navigation and living design documentation
sites.caution: Workbook depth can make the primary action ambiguous.

sites.name: Kaggriculture Fieldbook
sites.summary: A mono-led strategy fieldbook for game mechanics, agents, experiments, and findings.
sites.caution: Monospace everywhere reduces hierarchy at reading scale.

sites.name: SoundDeck
sites.summary: A light audio workbench that organizes generation, takes, projects, and connectors.
sites.pattern: Asset palette paired with a production workspace
sites.caution: Large tool surfaces need clear empty and loading states.

sites.name: Mumblings
sites.summary: A warm, minimal personal publication with an index and lightweight studio.
sites.pattern: Editorial front door with numbered archive views
sites.caution: Restrained navigation should still expose search and state.

sites.name: Cost Basis
sites.summary: A finance notebook with strong serif-like scale, warm paper, and structured archive views.
sites.pattern: Publication shell around a personal research system
sites.caution: Writing tools should stay visually separate from reading.

sites.name: Pokémon Rogue Dungeons
sites.summary: A playful, terrain-colored prototype that links a runnable expedition with design documentation.
sites.pattern: Playable object embedded inside its own design workbook
sites.caution: Novel visual language needs conventional interaction feedback.

sites.name: Margins and Weather
sites.summary: A publication deployment currently sharing the Mumblings shell and information architecture.
sites.pattern: Reusable publication starter with swappable identity
sites.caution: A shared template needs enough tokens to avoid clone-like results.

sites.name: Worth More?
sites.summary: A valuation game that pairs a simple decision loop with insight and data-studio views.
sites.pattern: Game mechanic as an entry point to structured data
sites.caution: Analytical depth should not interrupt the core play loop.

sites.name: Good Places, Together
sites.summary: A warm map-first restaurant guide built around place memory rather than rankings.
sites.pattern: Spatial browsing with an editorial point of view
sites.caution: Map controls and narrative cards compete on small screens.
